# Membrane RTP AAC Plugin v0.9.8 - Table of Contents

> RTP ACC Plugin for Membrane Multimedia Framework

## Pages

- [Membrane RTP AAC Plugin](https://membrane-rtp-aac-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://membrane-rtp-aac-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.RTP.AAC.Depayloader](https://membrane-rtp-aac-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTP.AAC.Depayloader.md):   Depayloader for RTP payloads constructed in accordance with RFC3640.
- [Membrane.RTP.AAC.Payloader](https://membrane-rtp-aac-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTP.AAC.Payloader.md):   Payloader wrapping non-encapsulated AAC frames into RTP payloads in accordance with RFC3640.
- [Membrane.RTP.AAC.Utils](https://membrane-rtp-aac-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTP.AAC.Utils.md):   This module defines helpers for payloading and depayloading non-encapsulated AAC into RTP payloads in accordance with RFC3640
